description.zh: 指定分页查询时，当前页的页码。
description.en: The page number. Pages start from page 1.

description.zh:
指定要查询的VPC列表是否开通了云蜜罐。取值：
- **true**：已开通
- **false**：未开通
description.en:
Specifies whether the VPCs to query have cloud honeypot enabled. Valid values:
- **true**: enabled
- **false**: disabled

description.zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
> 建议PageSize取值不要为空。
description.en:
The number of entries per page. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 entries are returned per page.
> We recommend that you specify this parameter.

description.zh:
指定要查询的蜜罐实例所在的VPC ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeVpcList](~~DescribeVpcList~~)接口获取VPC ID。
description.en:
The ID of the VPC in which the honeypot instance that you want to query resides.
> You can call the [DescribeVpcList](~~DescribeVpcList~~) operation to obtain the VPC ID.

description.zh:
指定要查询的蜜罐实例所在的VPC名称。
> 您可以调用[DescribeVpcList](~~DescribeVpcList~~)接口获取VPC名称。
description.en:
The name of the VPC in which the honeypot instance that you want to query resides.
> You can call the [DescribeVpcList](~~DescribeVpcList~~) operation to obtain the VPC name.

description.zh:
指定要查询的蜜罐实例所在的VPC区域ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeVpcList](~~DescribeVpcList~~)接口获取VPC所在区域的ID。
description.en:
The region ID of the VPC in which the honeypot instance that you want to query resides.
> You can call the [DescribeVpcList](~~DescribeVpcList~~) operation to obtain the region ID of the VPC.

descriptions.zh: 如果您在请求参数中只输入了Action，没有指定任一请求参数，云安全中心将返回所有的VPC列表（无论该VPC下是否创建了蜜罐实例）。
descriptions.en: If you specify only the Action parameter without specifying any other request parameters, Security Center returns the list of all VPCs regardless of whether honeypot instances are created in the VPCs.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas describe-vpc-honey-pot-list --vpc-id vpc-d7o009q63fqy21r8u0000 --vpc-name abcnet --vpc-region-id ap-southeast-2 --honey-pot-existence true --page-size 20 --current-page 2 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas DescribeVpcHoneyPotList --region cn-hangzhou --VpcId 'vpc-d7o009q63fqy21r8u0000' --PageSize 20 --HoneyPotExistence true --CurrentPage 2 --VpcRegionId 'ap-southeast-2' --VpcName abcnet
